{{Quote|You ''flatter'' me. But know this: unlike my companion here, I ''don't'' negotiate. I ''destroy'' and then I ''take''!|Cyreltov, to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="The Only Good Clanker" />}}
'''Cyreltov''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He worked for the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during a [[Battle of Bogoa|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bogoa]], tracking the rogue [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] [[Coppertop]]. The bounty hunter and Ventress attacked the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th]] troopers. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] threw a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], distracting him, and putting him in the path of a chunk of coral. However, Cyreltov caught it and threw it back. The skirmish ended with Coppertop surrendering. The droid then stole Cyreltov's [[Deactivator hold-out pistol/Legends|deactivator]] and shut himself down.<ref name="The Only Good Clanker" />

Cyreltov wore a suit of armor equipped with powerful weapons in the gauntlets that vastly increased his strength and a jetpack allowing him to fly.<ref name="The Only Good Clanker" />
